reviewMethod: Codex editorial review against each complete archived section and its source notes; not an independent legal review.

headings.title: Deposit limit
headings.reviewNote: Describes the topic without restating the amount as a stand-alone rule.

headings.title: Holding deposits and interest
headings.reviewNote: Includes the holding requirement, allocation of interest, and government-landlord exception.

headings.title: Deposit returns and itemized deductions
headings.reviewNote: Includes the alternative outcomes, deadline, mailing rule, and continuation paragraph.

headings.title: Grounds and conditions for withholding
headings.reviewNote: Covers rent, restoration, carpet-cleaning terms and receipts, notice, and mitigation conditions.

headings.title: Inspection notice and tenant attendance
headings.reviewNote: Covers notice, reasonable timing, and the tenant’s right to attend.

headings.title: Damages for wrongful withholding
headings.reviewNote: Does not state a universal remedy; preserves the source’s commercial-property annotation below.

headings.title: Additional damages and rent payments
headings.reviewNote: Covers both excess-damage recovery and limits on substituting the deposit for rent.

headings.title: Meaning of security deposit
headings.reviewNote: The definition and pet-deposit exclusion remain in the text.

headings.title: Establishing the court and appointing commissioners
headings.reviewNote: Includes county funding authorization and judicial-commission composition.

headings.title: Commissioners’ authority and limits
headings.reviewNote: Includes dispute types, relief, and the prohibition on ex parte hearings and orders.

headings.title: Commissioner qualifications, compensation, and restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Covers residency, service, outside work, and exclusion from state employment benefits.

headings.title: Court procedures and staffing
headings.reviewNote: Includes trial procedure, fact-finding duties, and staff assignments.

headings.title: Requesting an associate circuit court hearing
headings.reviewNote: Preserves the source’s mailing-or-service wording without supplying a missing object.

headings.title: Recording proceedings and seeking review
headings.reviewNote: Includes recording costs, trial de novo, appeals, and referenced procedures.

headings.title: Summons and service deadlines
headings.reviewNote: Keeps the distinct return and service-attempt periods in the source text.

headings.title: County responsibility for court costs
headings.reviewNote: Refers to establishing and operating the court, not individual litigants’ fees.

headings.title: Meaning of passenger car
headings.reviewNote: Includes the exclusions from this section’s definition.

headings.title: Belt requirements, exceptions, and enforcement limits
headings.reviewNote: Includes vehicle and passenger conditions, postal, medical, and agricultural exceptions, and enforcement limits.

headings.title: Restraints for children under sixteen
headings.reviewNote: Keeps the cross-reference to 307.179; supplies no additional age or restraint rule.

headings.title: Seat-belt evidence and damage reductions
headings.reviewNote: Includes comparative-negligence treatment, expert evidence, and the limit on reduction.

headings.title: Vehicle product claims and seat-belt evidence
headings.reviewNote: Identifies the separate rule for design, construction, manufacture, distribution, and sale actions; does not merge it with subsection 4.

headings.title: Fines, court costs, and points
headings.reviewNote: Includes the cross-referenced exception; avoids an unconditional penalty claim.

headings.title: Public information and program evaluation
headings.reviewNote: Includes public education, effectiveness evaluation, and reporting.

headings.title: When passengers outnumber seat belts
headings.reviewNote: Preserves seating conditions and the exception concerning drivers licensed under 302.178.

headings.title: Appointing and identifying the records custodian
headings.reviewNote: Includes maintenance responsibility and disclosure of identity and location upon request.

headings.title: Inspection, copying, and access restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Includes original-record removal permission and limits and exceptions on exclusive access arrangements.

headings.title: Request timing, format, and delays
headings.reviewNote: Does not promise production within three days; distinguishes action on a request from reasonable production delays.

headings.title: Written explanations for denied access
headings.reviewNote: Preserves the request requirement, legal citation, and separate statement deadline.

headings.title: Procedures for enacting ordinances
headings.reviewNote: Applies only to this source version, whose constitutional warning remains displayed; covers form, votes, readings, public copies, and signature or veto override.

headings.title: Exception for ordinances under 79.135
headings.reviewNote: Retains the exact cross-reference rather than inferring a category of exempt ordinances.
